name: .243 Cal-070gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Small to Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Hammer Hunter™ bullet was designed for the 1-10″ twist rate rifles. A super fast and flat shooting bullet that will retain 70% of its weight on impact making it a great bullet for varmints up to big game. We tested this bullet on several white tail deer out to 300y with excellent results." The product name says 70 gr; the specification says 69 gr.
